# Schedule

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Install and load required packages
if (!requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
}
if (!requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("kableExtra", quiet = TRUE)
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(kableExtra)
})

# Load the 2026 programme data
data <- read.csv("sched_basic.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = TRUE)

# Create the table data
table_data <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Time = ifelse(
      is.na(time_end) | time_end == "",
      time_start,
      paste0(time_start, "-", time_end)
    ),
    Author = ifelse(is.na(Speaker) | Speaker == "", "", Speaker),
    Event = event,
    Title = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("Biological computation: lessons from cell signalling", Title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        paste0('<a href="../../keynotes/key2026/ralitsa-madsen.html">', Title, '</a>'),
      grepl("Cerebrospinal Fluid Flow Cytometry", Title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        paste0('<a href="abstracts/csf-flow-cytometry.html">', Title, '</a>'),
      grepl("Scalable Bayesian Phylogenetic Models", Title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        paste0('<a href="abstracts/bayesian-phylogenetic-models.html">', Title, '</a>'),
      grepl("Central Active Research Data Storage", Title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        paste0('<a href="abstracts/cards.html">', Title, '</a>'),
      grepl("Distinguishing Crohn’s Disease", Title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        paste0('<a href="abstracts/ibd-microbiome.html">', Title, '</a>'),
      grepl("Amphotericin B Resistance", Title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        paste0('<a href="abstracts/amphotericin-resistance.html">', Title, '</a>'),
      grepl("Predicting Virus Evolution", Title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        paste0('<a href="abstracts/virus-evolution-plms.html">', Title, '</a>'),
      grepl("Walking and talking to the tree of life", Title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        paste0('<a href="abstracts/walking-tree-of-life.html">', Title, '</a>'),
      grepl("Prediction of antigenic evolution", Title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        paste0('<a href="abstracts/antigenic-evolution.html">', Title, '</a>'),
      TRUE ~ ifelse(is.na(Title) | Title == "", "", Title)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Time, Event, Author, Title)

# Create the table
table_data %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(
    escape = FALSE,
    align = "rlcl",
    table.attr = 'class="schedule-table table-responsive"'
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive")) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "15%", extra_css = "padding-right: 10px; white-space: nowrap;") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "20%", extra_css = "padding-right: 10px;") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "20%", extra_css = "padding-right: 10px;") %>%
  column_spec(4, width = "45%", extra_css = "word-wrap: break-word; overflow-wrap: break-word;")
```
